correctness.rationale: The nilpotent radical J=(x,y,xy) in rank-two exterior algebra consists of square-zero mutually anticommuting elements in every field, so arbitrary generator images yield q^6 unital endomorphisms parametrized by (P,ell)∈M2(Fq)×Fq² with multiplication (P,ell)(Q,m)=(PQ,ell Q+(det P)m). Idempotents are augmentation, identity and q lifts per rank-one projection P (q(q+1) such), totaling q²(q+1)+2. Commuting rank-one P,Q are equal or complementary. Distinct lifts with equal P do not commute, whereas any two lifts of P and I-P do commute with product augmentation. Thus deleting two universal maps yields q(q+1)/2 disjoint K_(q,q) components, q³(q+1)/2 maximal four-element Boolean commuting families, and q²(q+1)(q+5)+4 ordered commuting pairs. Direct independent F2 composition enumeration obtained 14 idempotents and 88 ordered commuting pairs. General proof applies any finite field, not only enumerated orders.
